rationale: The PINNED public half of the dedicated OFFLINE Ed25519 runtime-update signing key (D-2). This authority is SEPARATE from release/review-attestation-authority.json: it signs BOTH runtime manifest kinds — the engine runtime-update manifest (claudexor-runtime-<v>.tar.gz) and the four-target remote SSH runtime manifest (claudexor-remote-runtime-<v>-<target>.tar.gz) — never release attestations, and the two keys never cross. Domain separation between the two manifest kinds is the SIGNED `kind` field: the remote manifest's canonical signed bytes carry kind=claudexor-remote-runtime while the engine manifest's signed field set has no kind at all, so a signature sealed for one kind can never verify as the other. Both the macOS updater and `claudexor release check` pin this key and refuse any runtime manifest that is unsigned, signed by an unknown key, tampered, or a version regression. The private half lives offline at ~/.claudexor/keys/runtime-update-ed25519.pem (0600) and is used only during the owner's offline signing ceremonies (scripts/sign-runtime-manifest.mjs and scripts/sign-remote-runtime-manifest.mjs). Rotate by minting a new keypair, bumping keyId, and shipping the new public half in a signed DMG.
